title: The Beatles: Fab Four
description: Five levels through the band that changed pop music—and the world.

questions.question: Which city were The Beatles formed in?
questions.hint: A port city in northwest England

questions.question: After rising from Liverpool, what was The Beatles' first UK number-one single?
'Please Please Me' was the title track of their debut album—recorded in how many days?
questions.explanation: Their first album was famously recorded in one marathon session

questions.question: Who managed the Beatles and was called the Fifth Beatle?
questions.explanation: Epstein discovered them at the Cavern Club

questions.question: After Epstein's death, what was the Beatles' final album recorded together?
questions.explanation: Let It Be was released later but Abbey Road was their last sessions together

imageHint: An iconic zebra-crossing album cover from the late 1960s
